summary: Tested new job files/share/audit-trail feature batch. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed. Frontend UI: all 8 flow items in the request verified working (files card, share link, copy btn, upload/list/delete, share multi-email, non-company rejection, span-measurements includes no-GPS items, removed caption confirmed gone). Regression: Export/Map buttons present, interactive map still loads, no console errors.

minor.issue: Job-level edits do NOT stamp last_modified_by (only sets updated_at). Feature spec item #4 says 'Every add/edit by a team member is documented with email' and item note 'Job-level edits also stamp last_modified_by'. Poles/underground correctly stamp last_modified_by.

action_items: Stamp last_modified_by = current_user['email'] in PUT /api/jobs/{job_id} (routes/jobs.py update_job) to fully satisfy audit-trail requirement for job-level edits.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/jobs.py update_job (~line 245): missing 'last_modified_by' in update_data — inconsistent with poles/underground/share endpoints which correctly stamp it.

JobFilesShare.jsx clipboard fallback: navigator.clipboard.writeText may fail silently in some browsers/iframes; window.prompt fallback exists but toast still fires on failure with 'copied' text possibly misleading. Minor.
routes/jobs.py: file 1400+ lines — consider splitting share/files/photos/exports into separate modules (exceeds 700-line guideline).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted FILES-SHARE-UI-TEST job (id 3ec1dab2-2c68-415b-856c-fdd105baf448). Backend pytest fixture auto-creates/deletes FILES-SHARE-<uuid> jobs and registers a testcrew_<uuid>@byers.com user each run (users not deleted — no delete-user endpoint, low volume).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature batch fully working end-to-end. Only outstanding gap is job-level PUT missing last_modified_by stamp — see action_items. Backend test file test_job_files_share_audit.py can be reused for regression.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical bugs. Minor gap: update_job() in /app/backend/routes/jobs.py builds update_data without adding 'last_modified_by': current_user['email']. Fix is a 1-line addition next to the existing 'updated_at' assignment.
